item.title: seeCph: Test and Refactoring DAO's
item.author: theisrud@gmail.com (Theis Rud Halkjær)
item.description: This week was all getting test ready for all basic CRUD operations for all DAOS. For that i also needed to add exceptions to my DAO methods. I decided to do a big refactoring and make a generic Jig with all the basic CRUD operations for easier maintainance further on.
